earliestResponsibleBranch.branch: the PAGE_FURNITURE_RE test inside the values.length === 0 block
earliestResponsibleBranch.trace: segmentSourceUnits splits at line breaks, so "25000000" is its own unit -> scanQuantitativeValues finds nothing in it -> no inventory span covers it -> classifyUnaccountedFragment runs -> PAGE_FURNITURE_RE fires FIRST and returns an accounted disposition.
earliestResponsibleBranch.secondBranchOnTheSameFragment: Had PAGE_FURNITURE_RE alone been narrowed, the fragment would have fallen through to the STRUCTURAL_NOISE branch and been suppressed anyway: contentWords matches [A-Za-z] only, so a pure number scores zero content words. Verified pre-fix on "4.00", which reached STRUCTURAL_NOISE rather than page furniture. Both suppressions live in this one function and share one cause - letter-blindness - so closing the layer required closing both.

rootCause: PAGE_FURNITURE_RE was /^\s*(?:page\s+\d+(?:\s+of\s+\d+)?|[-–—\s]*\d+[-–—\s]*|\d+\s+of\s+\d+)\s*$/i. Its middle alternative matched ANY standalone integer, so numeric shape alone was taken as proof of pagination. The value route offered no backstop: the quantitative extractor's PATTERNS list has MONEY, PERCENT, RATIO, DAYS, PERIOD, DATE and MULTIPLIER but no bare-number kind, so an amount written without a currency symbol or unit produces zero values and the value guard never fires.

genericRuleImplemented.invariant: NUMERIC SHAPE ALONE DOES NOT PROVE PAGE FURNITURE. Pagination must be established by affirmative structure; unknown numeric source remains accountable.
paginationNowRequires: the "N of M" folio idiom ("12 of 40"), or
a number enclosed by dashes on BOTH sides ("- 12 -"), or
a dotted table-of-contents leader line (TOC_LEADER_RE, unchanged)
genericRuleImplemented.removed: the [-–—\s]*\d+[-–—\s]* alternative - there is no longer any rule equivalent to "standalone integer => page furniture"
genericRuleImplemented.digitGuard: A digit that survives enumerator stripping makes the fragment accountable, because the letter-blind rules cannot see it. Enumerator forms are stripped first, so "(2)" and "3." remain STRUCTURAL_NOISE as before.
genericRuleImplemented.ordering: The guard runs LAST, after pagination, citation, quoted-label and the caption rules, so every positive structural rule keeps first refusal. An ordering defect in the first draft of this patch put the guard before the caption rules and turned "SECTION 7.04 Dispositions." into a gap; the existing test caught it and the guard was moved rather than the test changed.
genericRuleImplemented.noLocationMagic: Nothing keys on position in the region, proximity to a newline, or any first-N/last-N character rule. Nothing keys on the fragment being short or isolated.
genericRuleImplemented.valueAccountingUntouched: Per §6 the quantitative extractor was NOT expanded - no bare-number pattern was added. Recognised values still block independently and are still never overridden by a noise or furniture classification; that guard (values.length === 0 gating the whole suppression block) is unchanged.
